# axiom_view (Resource)

Manages an Axiom view, a named APL query that can be queried like a dataset. The API token needs permission to manage views and query the underlying datasets. Views cannot reference other views, use dataset wildcards, or query datasets in different regions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "axiom_dataset" "logs" {
  name = "application-logs"
}

resource "axiom_view" "errors" {
  name        = "application-errors"
  description = "Application error events"
  apl_query   = <<-APL
    ['${axiom_dataset.logs.name}']
    | where level == "error"
  APL
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apl_query` (String) APL query defining the view. Must reference at least one dataset.
- `name` (String) View name. Must not match an existing dataset or view. Changing the name replaces the view.

### Optional

- `description` (String) View description. Removing it clears the description.

### Read-Only

- `datasets` (Set of String) Datasets referenced by the view, derived by Axiom from apl_query.
- `id` (String) View identifier, equal to its name. Use the name when importing an existing view.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a view by its name.
terraform import axiom_view.errors application-errors
```
